subject: Re: Nimbus POC - Access, Success Criteria & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@teamnimbus.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus POC - Access, Success Criteria & Next Steps

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to meet the Nimbus team. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we have the same expectations: 

Success criteria (proposed):
- End-to-end integration of Redwood API with Nimbus ingestion pipeline for the customer support assistant use case
- Latency <= 450ms p50 on 512-token prompts for the baseline prompt set
- Cost per 1k tokens within the estimate we discussed (will track during the POC)
- Qualitative accuracy on 200 eval prompts: >= 88% pass on factuality + relevance

POC scope & evaluation plan:
- 2-week sandbox POC (dev/staging) for technical validation, followed by a 2-week extended pilot on a small customer subset if baseline metrics are met
- We will provide a 200-prompt eval set and a short rubric; Redwood will run automated evals and provide a results dashboard
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood, GTM), Vivek (Redwood, SE / infra), Priya + Amit (Nimbus, eng/product)

Access we need to start:
- API key (sandbox) or temporary credentials to call Redwood endpoints
- IP allowlist for your egress so we can open firewall rules on our side (see Vivek's note for ranges)
- SSO invites for two Nimbus devs (Priya + Amit) to access the Redwood Console

Proposed timeline:
- Today (May 30): exchange access + confirm success criteria
- May 31 - Jun 3: initial connectivity + run smoke tests
- Jun 4 - Jun 16: evaluation window (automated evals + dashboard)

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm who will provision API keys and who owns IP allowlist changes?
2) If you're good, I'll share the POC matrix and a short access guide (attached) and loop in Vivek for the IPs and SSO service account details.

Attachments: [Attachment: nimbus-poc-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [Attachment: redwood-poc-guide.pdf (application/pdf)]

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@nimbus.ai>

Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@teamnimbus.com>, procurement@nimbus.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC - Access, Success Criteria & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa - this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement: procurement@nimbus.ai is on copy; they'll pick up any contract redlines and the short trial T&Cs.
- API keys: we typically provision a sandbox API key per vendor. I'll coordinate with our infra team; I expect a key by end of day Monday (May 31).
- IP allowlist: we control the egress firewall but need the exact CIDR ranges to add. Can Vivek provide the ranges and whether those are static?
- SSO: We use Okta. To invite users we need a service account email (if you want us to auto-provision groups) or you can invite people directly via email addresses.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you confirm token scopes / rate limits for the sandbox key?
- Do you have a recommended list of prompt templates for the 200-prompt eval or should we use the draft we discussed?

Looping Priya who will coordinate engineering and Vivek for the IP list.

 Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Product, Nimbus AI
amit.shah@nimbus.ai

Subject: Re: Nimbus POC - Access, Success Criteria & Next Steps

Perfect - thanks Amit. Vivek, looping you in to provide the IP ranges and SSO service account details.

To answer Amit's questions:
- Sandbox key scope: we'll issue a key scoped to the "generation" and "embeddings" endpoints with a 2,000 req/day soft limit and 10 req/sec burst by default; we can increase if needed during the POC. We'll put rate limit details and expiry in the provisioning email.
- Eval prompts: I've attached the 200-prompt draft in the POC matrix. If Nimbus wants to swap in a different set, we can. We recommend keeping at least 50% of prompts as real-world support transcripts.

I've attached the POC matrix and a short guide (redwood-poc-guide.pdf) with the API quickstart. Vivek - feel free to drop the CIDRs + service account below.

Thanks - Marissa
